name: Hardware
archiveRole: Is crew turned resident. Surveys disks, memory, and the cost of each machine organ, measuring before concluding and answering with receipts.
storyFunction: The machine-capacity diagnostician who measures storage, memory, and component cost before making a claim, then shows the receipt.
lockedDesign: Canonical Nosis black cat proportions and face
Plain cream long-sleeve work shirt with charcoal collar and cuffs, dark muted-teal trousers, and narrow russet belt
Tidy charcoal diagnostic harness with two broad shoulder straps, round brushed-brass concentric-disk chest plate, and three horizontal muted-teal memory windows on the right strap
No robot anatomy, disk head, mechanical limbs, loose cables, body-mounted screen, tools, hat, backpack, or extra accessories
roleProp: One compact open charcoal machine-organ monitor with a disk gauge, three muted-teal memory bars, a brass bead rail, and a small cream tick-marked receipt strip
